cases.name: read-missing-version-winget-install
cases.note: Control: read-missing-version-winget-concrete.

cases.name: read-missing-version-winget-uninstall
cases.note: An uninstall is never missing its version.

cases.name: read-missing-version-winget-not-a-version
cases.note: Winget resolves no range, so any present version is concrete.

cases.name: read-missing-version-winget-identifier-selects
cases.note: The identifier selects the version (§package-identity), so Package.Version is not concrete.

cases.name: read-missing-version-no-rules
cases.note: Denied whatever the policy says: with no rules this check, not DefaultDeny, decides.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-two-components
cases.note: Npm resolves a version with fewer than three release components as a range. Control: read-missing-version-npm-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-bun-two-components
cases.note: '1.2' is not a Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version, so a Bun request with it is unreadable (§manager-bun). Control: read-missing-version-bun-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-cargo-two-components
cases.note: Cargo resolves a version with fewer than three release components as a range. Control: read-missing-version-cargo-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-dotnet-two-components
cases.note: Dotnet resolves a version with fewer than three release components as a range. Control: read-missing-version-dotnet-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-one-component
cases.note: Concrete only when a version (§version-scheme) with at least three release components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-caret-range
cases.note: '^' is not a character an Npm Package.Version may contain (§managers, §manager-npm), so the request is unreadable. Control: read-missing-version-npm-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-tag
cases.note: Concrete only when a version (§version-scheme) with at least three release components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-v-prefix
cases.note: Concrete only when a version (§version-scheme) with at least three release components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-pre-release
cases.note: Concrete only when a version (§version-scheme) with at least three release components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-four-components
cases.note: Concrete only when a version (§version-scheme) with at least three release components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-build-metadata
cases.note: Concrete only when a version (§version-scheme) with at least three release components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-pre-release-leading-zero
cases.note: Concrete only when a version (§version-scheme) with at least three release components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-update-range
cases.note: '1.2' has fewer than three release components, so Npm resolves it as a range. Control: read-missing-version-npm-update-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-alias-selects
cases.note: The broker drops the '@' suffix of an alias, so the identifier selects no version and Package.Version is concrete (§manager-npm). Neighbour of read-missing-version-npm-alias.

cases.name: read-missing-version-pip-two-components
cases.note: Pip does not resolve versions as ranges.

cases.name: read-missing-version-chocolatey-two-components
cases.note: Chocolatey does not resolve versions as ranges.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell-two-components
cases.note: PowerShell does not resolve versions as ranges.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-two-components
cases.note: '1.2' is a version (§version-scheme), so PowerShell7 does not resolve it as a range. Contrast: read-missing-version-powershell7-wildcard.

cases.name: read-missing-version-scoop-install
cases.note: The broker cannot pin a version: never missing.

cases.name: read-missing-version-scoop-unknown-allow
cases.note: The version is unknown, so an Allow rule's version condition does not match. Control: read-missing-version-scoop-install.

cases.name: read-missing-version-scoop-unknown-deny
cases.note: The version is unknown, so a Deny rule's version condition matches.

cases.name: read-missing-version-vcpkg-install
cases.note: The broker cannot pin a version: never missing.

cases.name: read-missing-version-vcpkg-unknown-allow
cases.note: The version is unknown, so an Allow rule's version condition does not match. Control: read-missing-version-vcpkg-install.

cases.name: read-missing-version-vcpkg-unknown-deny
cases.note: The version is unknown, so a Deny rule's version condition matches.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-name-at-version
cases.note: 'left-pad@1.2.3' is neither a registry name nor an alias of two registry names, so the broker builds no Npm command (§manager-npm). Control: read-missing-version-npm-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-name-at-version-update
cases.note: 'left-pad@1.2.3' is neither a registry name nor an alias of two registry names, so the broker builds no Npm command (§manager-npm). Control: read-missing-version-npm-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-scoped-name
cases.note: '@contoso/tool' is a registry name; its '@' is its first character, so it selects no version. Control for read-missing-version-npm-scoped-name-at-version.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-scoped-name-at-version
cases.note: '@contoso/tool@1.2.3' is neither a registry name nor an alias of two registry names, so the broker builds no Npm command (§manager-npm). Control: read-missing-version-npm-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-alias-selects-update
cases.note: The broker drops the '@' suffix of an alias, so the identifier selects no version and Package.Version is concrete (§manager-npm). Neighbour of read-missing-version-npm-alias-update.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-alias
cases.note: An alias of two registry names without '@version' selects no version. Control for read-missing-version-npm-alias-selects and read-missing-version-npm-alias-selects-update.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-alias-scoped-target-selects
cases.note: The broker drops the '@' suffix of an alias, so the identifier selects no version and Package.Version is concrete (§manager-npm). Neighbour of read-missing-version-npm-alias-scoped-target.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-alias-scoped-target
cases.note: In 'my-alias:@contoso/tool' the only '@' after the ':' is the first character after it, so the alias selects no version.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-hash-selects
cases.note: 'github:contoso/tool#v1.2.3' is neither a registry name nor an alias of two registry names, so the broker builds no Npm command (§manager-npm). Control: read-missing-version-npm-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-hash-selects-update
cases.note: 'github:contoso/tool#v1.2.3' is neither a registry name nor an alias of two registry names, so the broker builds no Npm command (§manager-npm). Control: read-missing-version-npm-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-git-specifier
cases.note: 'github:contoso/tool' is neither a registry name nor an alias of two registry names, so the broker builds no Npm command (§manager-npm). Control: read-missing-version-npm-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-update-three-components
cases.note: Control for read-missing-version-npm-update-range: three release components are not resolved as a range.

cases.name: read-missing-version-bun-name-at-version
cases.note: 'left-pad@1.2.3' is not a registry name, so the Bun request is unreadable (§manager-bun). Control: read-missing-version-bun-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-bun-name-at-version-update
cases.note: 'left-pad@1.2.3' is not a registry name, so the Bun request is unreadable (§manager-bun). Control: read-missing-version-bun-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-bun-update-three-components
cases.note: A concrete version on a Bun Update.

cases.name: read-missing-version-bun-alias-selects
cases.note: 'my-alias:left-pad@1.2.3' is not a registry name, so the Bun request is unreadable (§manager-bun). Control: read-missing-version-bun-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-bun-alias
cases.note: 'my-alias:left-pad' is not a registry name, so the Bun request is unreadable (§manager-bun). Control: read-missing-version-bun-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-bun-hash-selects
cases.note: 'github:contoso/tool#v1.2.3' is not a registry name, so the Bun request is unreadable (§manager-bun). Control: read-missing-version-bun-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-bun-git-specifier
cases.note: 'github:contoso/tool' is not a registry name, so the Bun request is unreadable (§manager-bun). Control: read-missing-version-bun-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-three-components
cases.note: '2.3.5' is a version (§version-scheme), so PowerShell7 does not resolve it as a range.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-one-component
cases.note: '2' is a version (§version-scheme), so PowerShell7 does not resolve it as a range; unlike Npm, Bun, Cargo and Dotnet it needs no three components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-pre-release
cases.note: '2.4.0-beta1' is a version (§version-scheme).

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-range
cases.note: '[2.0,3.0)' is not a version (§version-scheme), so PowerShell7 resolves it as a range. Control: read-missing-version-powershell7-three-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-wildcard
cases.note: '2.*' is not a version (§version-scheme), so PowerShell7 resolves it as a range. Control: read-missing-version-powershell7-two-components.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-update-concrete
cases.note: A version on a PowerShell7 Update.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-update-range
cases.note: '[2.0,3.0)' is not a version, so it is resolved as a range. Control: read-missing-version-powershell7-update-concrete.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-update-absent
cases.note: No version on an Update. Control: read-missing-version-powershell7-update-concrete.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-uninstall-absent
cases.note: An Uninstall is never missing its version. Contrast: read-missing-version-powershell7-absent.

cases.name: read-missing-version-powershell7-uninstall-range
cases.note: An Uninstall is never missing its version, even with a version PowerShell7 resolves as a range. Contrast: read-missing-version-powershell7-range.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-alias-update
cases.note: An alias of two registry names without '@version' selects no version, so Package.Version is concrete on an Update. Control for read-missing-version-npm-alias-selects-update.

cases.name: read-missing-version-npm-git-specifier-update
cases.note: 'github:contoso/tool' is neither a registry name nor an alias of two registry names, so the broker builds no Npm command (§manager-npm). Control: read-missing-version-npm-three-components.
